arStrings.szText: You have fought the creatures of Hatred, yes? We fought them too, here in the swamps, but in the end they reached the Tree.
And then the heads went missing... I have tried to call the Coven every day since I discovered this, but none have yet answered. So I found you.
Somber. Grim. Player is a sliver of hope.
I will teach you now the witchcraft I promised. Use it to follow what remains of the Tree’s whispers and seek the missing heads. Do this, and I will teach more.
Back to the deal. Daunted yet determined to fix things.
